data.name: Vivek
data.gender_notes: Vivek is used as a male name in hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + vic, 'to sift' — 'discrimination, wisdom'. Its root is Sanskrit vi + vic. A central concept in Vedanta philosophy. Vivek is a Sanskrit name meaning “Discrimination; wisdom; judgement”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Vivek expresses “Discrimination; wisdom; judgement”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit vi, 'apart', + vic, 'to sift' — 'discrimination, wisdom'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Vivek total 24, reducing to 6. Number 6 is associated with responsibility, care and harmony.

vedic_reference.note: Vivek is the name of a god in Hindu mythology, a form of the god Rudra. It is also a common name in Hinduism.
